---
title: "F-CRHF — Collision-resistant hashing"
status: "Open"
layer: 2
---

*F-CRHF* (Collision-resistant hashing) is part of *Layer 2: Cryptographic Library and Symmetric Primitives* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: open — no accepted UC formulation exists yet.

This is one of several purely local, hardness-based primitives (alongside *F-OWF*, *F-PRG*, and *F-MHF*) with no cross-party interface to idealize — the UC composition theorem gives nothing here that a standard hybrid argument doesn't already provide. It's included in this encyclopedia only to record that absence explicitly.
